s1.text: Flow: Scan reads all 7 types for This Mac or for one project folder, and sorts every item into Yours, Read-only or Needs attention; click a group to list it across types. Projects adds a folder to manage. Or pick one type in the rail for Sources, then the list. Edit shows only on Personal items.

s4.text: Style follows the reference screenshots: flat near-black, DM Sans, hairline borders, outlined pills, left icon rail, particle visuals. No gradients. The accent is one CSS variable, --acc (lime #D4F53C); yellow is kept only to mark Yours, the editable items.

s5.text: Sample data only. Counts and particles are computed from it. The scan is a 4-second timer, not a real file read; Stop keeps partial results. Browse always previews the sample folder tia-scl-tools. Restore and Edit are stubs. Nothing was rendered or checked in a browser.

s2.text: Hooks have no native per-hook disable (only disableAllHooks). The app removes the entry and keeps a copy to restore.

s3.text: The source decides the badge. Only a local directory marketplace becomes Personal and editable.
